item.title: Debian and Ubuntu APT Flaw Lets MitM Attackers Swap Verified Packages and Run Code as Root

item.title: Researchers Uncover Prompt Adware Hidden in OpenAI Codex Jailbreak Toolkit

item.title: Critical Rails Flaw Lets Attackers Write Server Files via Crafted ImageMagick Uploads
item.description: A critical flaw in Ruby on Rails could allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on an app's server by uploading a crafted file if the app processes uploads using ImageMagick. The Rails project disclosed the flaw in an advisory and fixed it in versions 8.1.4.1 and 8.0.5.2.
